name: Border Crossings
summary: At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister sends you after Dalaran's supplies and the reason the Kirin Tor support Ambermill. Their crates pass through Silverpine Forest on the way to a Dalaran camp near Pyrewood Village.

sections.title: Supplies on the Frontier
sections.body: Wagons bring Dalaran's supplies and arcane goods from the Hillsbrad Foothills through Silverpine Forest. They serve the outposts and staging grounds along the way. Just north of Pyrewood Village, a camp holds Dalaran personnel who watch the road. Ambermill is the main human stronghold still standing in eastern Silverpine, and Dalaran continues to support it.

sections.title: The Forsaken's Suspicion
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister and the Forsaken leaders at the Sepulcher want to know why Dalaran gives Ambermill so much support. They suspect the Kirin Tor would not risk lives and supplies deep in Forsaken territory for a provincial town alone. Some greater strategic or magical purpose may be behind it. Intercepting the crates could show the Forsaken what Dalaran is sending west.

sections.title: Uncovering the Cargo
sections.body: The crate Allister asks you to retrieve holds more than provisions. Inside are aged maps of Silverpine Forest and western Lordaeron, along with a magical pendant. The cargo also includes arcane items and maps, but its purpose remains unclear.

faq.q: Why are Dalaran wizards active in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Dalaran works from Ambermill to keep a human and Alliance presence in western Lordaeron. Shadow Priest Allister suspects the Kirin Tor seek more than the defense of a rural hamlet, so the Forsaken target their supply lines.

faq.q: Where are the Dalaran crates located?
faq.answer: The crates are at a Dalaran camp just north of Pyrewood Village, off the main road. Dalaran magi and guards watch over them.

faq.q: What is inside the Dalaran crate?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister does not know what Dalaran is shipping. He asks you to bring back the contents of a crate from the camp north of Pyrewood Village so he can investigate.
Shadow Priest Allister is a prominent Forsaken leader at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He directs intelligence efforts and strikes against human holdouts and Dalaran's incursions.

faq.q: How are the supplies getting into Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Wagons carry the shipments from Dalaran's territory in the Hillsbrad Foothills through the border pass into Silverpine. From there, they reach staging camps near Ambermill and Pyrewood.

faq.q: What follows the completion of this quest?
faq.answer: After inspecting the crate, take what you discover to Shadow Priest Allister for study in Maps and Runes.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know the Forsaken cannot allow a Dalaran outpost to go unchecked on their southern flank, especially one sending supplies under the Sepulcher's nose.
As a Forsaken priest, you help Shadow Priest Allister secure the domain of the Forsaken priesthood against holy and arcane rivals.
As a Horde spellcaster, you share an interest in Dalaran's magical shipments and what they may reveal about the Kirin Tor's secrets and protective wards in Lordaeron.
